_doc: The game's sound list, edited in Tools > gishadev > SFX Prep. Categories hold processing and export settings (channels 1 = mono, 2 = stereo; lufs = target loudness; max_len = longest one-shot in seconds; loop_seconds and crossfade for Loop sounds, 0 = the config's; stream_after = clips longer than this many seconds stream, 0 = never; quality = Vorbis quality 0..1). Sounds get candidates from the sfx-scout skill and from .wav files dropped on the window.
